commits.message:
[inference] Refresh the TPU vLLM pair (#9301)

Refresh Marin's TPU serving pair to vLLM
`fb02daf1d7139d2adaeb0588448649591657d1e3` and tpu-inference
`a8fc5c9f6d14ac5a3b1f97d5c296d6015a73cabe`. The TPU fork is staged on
upstream stable release `v0.29.0` at
`34535b114a213b1e5668de2ea3b62bceb377efb1`. Marin installs both exact
pins in one isolated serving environment.

The validated `marin-community/tpu-inference/main-next` tip is
`a8fc5c9f6d14ac5a3b1f97d5c296d6015a73cabe`, tagged `main-20260928`. That
fork's protected `main` remains at
`2c93701988f9c499556b8d00715f67eedc9d9fad`, backed up by
`main-backup/20260928/pre-2c937019`. After confirming both branch tips,
an administrator with protected-branch bypass must run `git push
--force-with-lease=main:2c93701988f9c499556b8d00715f67eedc9d9fad origin
main-next:main` in the TPU fork before this draft PR merges. The
maintained fork branch will then point at Marin's exact pin. vLLM needs
no branch promotion. Keep the candidate prerelease in
`marin-community/vllm` Releases until the fork promotion and this PR
merge finish.

The [exact-pair candidate
build](https://github.com/marin-community/vllm/actions/runs/36450040969)
and [v6e-8 TPU
qualification](https://github.com/marin-community/vllm/actions/runs/36450337073)
passed. The probe served Qwen3-0.6B with tensor parallelism 8, returned
four completions with at least 65 tokens each, and measured 180.87
output tokens per second. Downloaded public wheels matched the SHA256
hashes in the published candidate manifest. The pending protected-branch
swap is the remaining release step.

<details>
<summary>Selection and replay evidence</summary>

The newest eligible upstream tpu-inference release is
[v0.29.0](https://github.com/vllm-project/tpu-inference/releases/tag/v0.29.0).
Its tagged commit adds documentation to the previous upstream base. The
earlier 11-patch Marin overlay replayed onto that tag without source
conflicts. Nine patches are identical; the final two retain the same
code and clarify their carry rationale. A twelfth carry preserves the
Marin style and CI update merged to protected `main` after the September
21 candidate staging.

The selected vLLM SHA is reachable from protected
`marin-community/vllm/main` (`git merge-base --is-ancestor
fb02daf1d7139d2adaeb0588448649591657d1e3
01911be34fac8715347962a8d791ca34a879e01e`). It is also the source of the
immutable [`marin-vllm-gpu-20260920-fb02daf1d713` release
tag](https://github.com/marin-community/vllm/releases/tag/marin-vllm-gpu-20260920-fb02daf1d713).
The TPU candidate uses that source SHA; commits after that SHA change
`vllm/` code but are absent from this TPU wheel.

| Class | Commits | Disposition | Reason |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| Carry | 12 | Replayed the overlay and preserved the later CI update |
The GrugMoE, token-decision, prompt-logprobs, dependency, CI, and
fork-operations deltas remain in use. |
| Drop | 0 | None | The upstream release adds documentation and absorbs
none of these patches. |
| Fix | 0 | None | No fork source repair was needed. |

[Fork
CI](https://github.com/marin-community/tpu-inference/actions/runs/36449709933)
passed lint, the vendored standards check, GrugMoE CPU tests, nightly
tests, and the token-decision import check. Marin's generated pin check,
changed-file lint, and affected safe tests passed on the current-main
branch (290 passed, 1 skipped). The advisory lint review found no
issues. The exact public candidate is
[`marin-vllm-tpu-candidate-fb02daf1d713-a8fc5c9f6d14-01911be34fac-22c1f1ffff08`](https://github.com/marin-community/vllm/releases/tag/marin-vllm-tpu-candidate-fb02daf1d713-a8fc5c9f6d14-01911be34fac-22c1f1ffff08).

</details>

commits.message:
datakit: submit the tier 2 ferry at production priority (#9736)

Submit the tier 2 datakit ferry with `--priority production`, matching
tier 1 and tier 3. #9727 pinned tier 1 and tier 2 to `us-west4`; they
run at about the same time each day, and tier 1 uses production
priority.

On 2026-10-04, tier 1 preempted the tier 2 shared workers 148 times. The
worker group exhausted its retries, and four steps failed
([run](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/actions/runs/37204337504)).
The test runs for #9727 ran tier 1 and tier 2 at the same time, both at
production priority, and both passed.

commits.author: ravwojdyla-agent
commits.message:
datakit: run the ferries on the reference DAG (#9727)

Run the tier 1, 2, and 3 datakit ferries on the reference datakit DAG.
Previously, each ferry copied the dedup pipeline, including
`verify_fuzzy_dups` and its memory store on 1,000 workers with 160 GB
each. The tier 3 canary had failed every week since 2026-08-17 because
that pool did not become ready.[^1]

`experiments/ferries/datakit_reference_ferry.py` now supplies each
ferry's sources and `PipelineScale` to `reference_datakit_steps`. Its
outputs use a one-day TTL prefix under `MARIN_PREFIX`. The quality model
and decon eval corpus also resolve against `MARIN_PREFIX`, so they must
be present in the ferry region.[^2] `reference_datakit_steps` accepts
`output_prefix`, and its library step builders accept
`output_path_prefix`; these replace `_route_outputs` in
`zephyr_benchmark.py`. `reference_pipeline.py` defines
`shared_zephyr_context` and `QUALITY_MODEL_VERSION` for its `main()`,
the ferries, and `reference_training_pipeline.py`.

The tier 1 and 2 workflows are pinned to `us-west4`, and the tier 2
driver requests `--memory=8G`. Ferry workers request at most 64 GB of
disk: Marin VMs have 100 GB, so larger requests never schedule and
Zephyr retries them until the workflow times out. `plan_large_clusters`
now handles merges of multiple count files without `ArrowInvalid`.
Tokenize reports read token lengths with `pc.list_value_length` instead
of loading `input_ids` as Python lists, avoiding the observed OOM.
`collect_perf_metrics.py` reads stage times from the StepRunner log
because stages on the shared pool have no child jobs.
`validate_ferry_outputs.py` checks that fuzzy dedup removed records and
that each bucket's leaf cache ledgers contain exactly the kept records.

All three tiers ran concurrently on this branch with the workflow
flags.[^3] Tier 1 took 1h34m, compared with 51m alone; its store held
9.02M records and `validate_ferry_outputs.py` passed. Tier 2 took 2h46m.
Tier 3 took 2h31m and stored 241.8M of 275.5M records, totaling 170B
tokens.

[^1]: #8948 and #9494 track this failure. After this change,
`verify_fuzzy_dups` and the memory store have no pipeline callers, only
scripts and tests; they can be removed in a later PR.
[^2]: I copied them to `gs://marin-us-west4` and `gs://marin-eu-west4`.
See `experiments/ferries/OPS.md`.
[^3]: Tier 1 and tier 2 stalled after a preemptible host was lost. Iris
started a new attempt with the same Zephyr worker ID while the old
attempt still held a shard, leaving that shard in flight on a worker
that sent heartbeats but never ran it. I preempted the idle retried
workers to continue. This Zephyr/Iris bug is outside this PR. In
`europe-west4`, the driver and coordinator logs did not reach the log
store, so the tier 3 perf report will have no stage times.

Fixes #9494
